scenarios.scenario_name: Auto-Approve Tariff-Rated Chargesets on Load Completion
scenarios.scenario_description: Auto-approve charge sets for BWS Logistics import drayage loads when the load is completed, all line items are from the approved BWS charge list at standard rates, all charges are tariff-rated (Base Price, Pre-Pull, Chassis), there are no off-menu charges, no off-rate amounts, no duplicate charges, no undefined 'other' lines, and no hand-entered charges that should be tariff-rated. Bill-only jobs and hand-entered charges (Warehouse Storage, Transload, Detention, Heavy Container Fee) are routed to manual review. The 'other' $6 charge is never auto-approved.

execution_plan.description: Search for the load to get full load details including type, status, and customer
Get charge list for the load to inspect all chargesets and their line items
execution_plan.condition: ALL of the following must be true from Step 0: (1) callerName contains 'BWS' (case-insensitive). If not: STOP, return CONDITION_NOT_MET 'Not a BWS Logistics load'. (2) Load must be in COMPLETED status. If not: STOP, return CONDITION_NOT_MET 'Load is not completed yet'. (3) type_of_load must be 'IMPORT'. If type_of_load is 'BILL_ONLY': STOP, return CONDITION_NOT_MET 'Bill-only jobs require manual review — hand-entered charges not eligible for auto-approval'.

execution_plan.description: Approve all eligible chargesets that pass all BWS validation rules
execution_plan.condition:
For EACH chargeset from Step 1 with status DRAFT or UNAPPROVED, validate ALL of the following. If ANY fails for a chargeset, exclude it and route to manual review:
1. Base Price charge must be present in the default chargeset (isDefault=true) and must be tariff-rated (chargeType in [CUSTOMER_RATES, DYNAMIC_PRICING, SYSTEM_GENERATED, PROFILE_RATES, ZIPCODE_RATES, CITYSTATE_RATES, EDI_204]).
2. There must be NO separate 'Fuel Surcharge' or 'Fuel' line item — BWS line haul is all-in. If a Fuel Surcharge line exists: exclude chargeset, flag for review as data error.
3. Every charge name must be one of: 'Base Price', 'Pre-Pull', 'Chassis', 'Yard Storage', 'Empty Load Storage', 'Port Detention', 'Delivery Detention', 'Heavy Container Fee', 'Warehouse Storage', 'Transload'. Any charge not in this list is off-menu — exclude chargeset.
4. No charge name may contain 'other' (case-insensitive). If an 'other' line exists: exclude chargeset.
5. No duplicate charges (no two charges with the same name in the same chargeset).
6. Only tariff-rated charges may be auto-approved: Base Price, Pre-Pull, Chassis. These must have chargeType in [CUSTOMER_RATES, DYNAMIC_PRICING, SYSTEM_GENERATED, PROFILE_RATES, ZIPCODE_RATES, CITYSTATE_RATES, EDI_204]. If any of these are hand-entered (chargeType = 'MANUALLY_CHANGED'), exclude chargeset — this signals a tariff gap.
7. Hand-entered charges (Warehouse Storage, Transload, Port Detention, Delivery Detention, Heavy Container Fee) must NOT be present on import drayage chargesets being auto-approved. If present, exclude chargeset — these require manual review until tariff carries them.
8. Rate validation for tariff-rated charges: Base Price ~$540, Pre-Pull ~$125, Chassis ~$40. If any amount deviates significantly from standard rate, exclude chargeset.
9. Time-based charges (Yard Storage, Empty Load Storage) must have quantity from system dwell tracking (chargeType not MANUALLY_CHANGED for unit count). If hand-entered quantity, exclude chargeset.
If no chargesets pass all validations: STOP, return CONDITION_NOT_MET 'No chargesets eligible for auto-approval — all routed to manual review'.

execution_plan.description: Fetch exception template for auto-approval blocked
execution_plan.condition: Step 2 returned CONDITION_NOT_MET or one or more chargesets were excluded from approval due to validation failures

execution_plan.description: Log exception for chargesets that failed validation and were routed to manual review

Routed to manual review.

parameters.message: Load {{reference_number}} — BWS auto-approval blocked. One or more chargesets routed to manual review. See exception log for details.

execution_plan.condition: Step 4 succeeded

scenarios.summerized_steps:
<plan_instruction>
Plan Steps for: Auto-Approve Tariff-Rated Chargesets on Load Completion

============================================================

Step 1: Search for the load to get full load details including type, status, and customer
  Tool: search-loads
  Parameters:
    searchTerm = "{{reference_number}}"
    fieldsToReturn = ["_id", "reference_number", "type_of_load", "status", "callerName", "driverOrder", "documents"]

Step 2: Get charge list for the load to inspect all chargesets and their line items
  Tool: get-charge-list
  Parameters:
    loadNumbers = ["{{reference_number}}"]
  Depends on: Step 1
  Condition: ALL of the following must be true from Step 1:
    - callerName from {{0.callerName}} contains 'BWS' (case-insensitive). If not: STOP, return CONDITION_NOT_MET 'Not a BWS Logistics load'.
    - Load must be in COMPLETED status from {{0.status}}. If not: STOP, return CONDITION_NOT_MET 'Load is not completed yet'.
    - type_of_load from {{0.type_of_load}} must be 'IMPORT'. If type_of_load is 'BILL_ONLY': STOP, return CONDITION_NOT_MET 'Bill-only jobs require manual review — hand-entered charges not eligible for auto-approval'.

Step 3: Approve all eligible chargesets that pass all BWS validation rules
  Tool: approve-chargesets
  Parameters:
    chargeSetIds = "{{eligible_chargeset_ids}}"
    loadId = "{{0._id}}"
  Depends on: Step 1, Step 2
  Condition: For EACH chargeset from Step 2 with status DRAFT or UNAPPROVED, validate ALL of the following. If ANY fails for a chargeset, exclude it and route to manual review:
    1. Base Price charge must be present in the default chargeset (isDefault=true) and must be tariff-rated (chargeType in [CUSTOMER_RATES, DYNAMIC_PRICING, SYSTEM_GENERATED, PROFILE_RATES, ZIPCODE_RATES, CITYSTATE_RATES, EDI_204]).
    2. There must be NO separate 'Fuel Surcharge' or 'Fuel' line item — BWS line haul is all-in. If a Fuel Surcharge line exists: exclude chargeset, flag as data error.
    3. Every charge name must be one of: 'Base Price', 'Pre-Pull', 'Chassis', 'Yard Storage', 'Empty Load Storage', 'Port Detention', 'Delivery Detention', 'Heavy Container Fee', 'Warehouse Storage', 'Transload'. Any charge not in this list is off-menu — exclude chargeset.
    4. No charge name may contain 'other' (case-insensitive). If an 'other' line exists: exclude chargeset.
    5. No duplicate charges (no two charges with the same name in the same chargeset).
    6. Only tariff-rated charges may be auto-approved: Base Price, Pre-Pull, Chassis. These must have chargeType in [CUSTOMER_RATES, DYNAMIC_PRICING, SYSTEM_GENERATED, PROFILE_RATES, ZIPCODE_RATES, CITYSTATE_RATES, EDI_204]. If any of these are hand-entered (chargeType = 'MANUALLY_CHANGED'), exclude chargeset — this signals a tariff gap.
    7. Hand-entered charges (Warehouse Storage, Transload, Port Detention, Delivery Detention, Heavy Container Fee) must NOT be present on import drayage chargesets being auto-approved. If present, exclude chargeset — these require manual review until tariff carries them.
    8. Rate validation for tariff-rated charges: Base Price ~$540, Pre-Pull ~$125, Chassis ~$40. If any amount deviates significantly from standard rate, exclude chargeset.
    9. Time-based charges (Yard Storage, Empty Load Storage) must have quantity from system dwell tracking (chargeType not MANUALLY_CHANGED for unit count). If hand-entered quantity, exclude chargeset.
    If no chargesets pass all validations: STOP, return CONDITION_NOT_MET 'No chargesets eligible for auto-approval — all routed to manual review'.

--- ESCALATION (validation failures detected) ---

Step 4: Fetch exception template for auto-approval blocked
  Tool: get_exception_template
  Parameters:
    exception_type = "Charge Approval Blocked"
    request_type = "PRICING_AND_BILLING"
  Depends on: Step 3
  Condition: Step 3 returned CONDITION_NOT_MET or one or more chargesets were excluded from approval due to validation failures

Step 5: Log exception for chargesets that failed validation and were routed to manual review
  Tool: create-ai-request-log
  Parameters:
    agentName = "BILLING_AGENT"
    status = "AI_REQUESTED"
    category = "BWS Auto-Approval Blocked"
    exceptionType = "Charge Approval Blocked"
    requestType = "PRICING_AND_BILLING"
    exceptionDetail = "One or more BWS chargesets could not be auto-approved. Reasons may include: off-menu charge, off-rate amount, 'other' line present, hand-entered charge that should be tariff-rated, duplicate charge, Fuel Surcharge line present (BWS is all-in), or hand-entered detention/storage quantity. Routed to manual review."
    requestContext = "Load {{reference_number}}, Customer: BWS Logistics, type: IMPORT drayage."
    entities = [{"entityType": "LOAD", "entityId": "{{0._id}}", "entityName": "{{reference_number}}"}]
  Depends on: Step 4
  Condition: Step 4 succeeded (exception template fetched)

Step 6: Post exception to channel via Captain
  Tool: captain_post
  Parameters:
    ai_log_id = "{{4._id}}"
    channel_name = "Exceptions-Handling"
    message = "Load {{reference_number}} — BWS auto-approval blocked. One or more chargesets routed to manual review. See exception log for details."
  Depends on: Step 5
  Condition: Step 5 succeeded

</plan_instruction>
scenarios.reasoning: This is the main auto-approval scenario for BWS import drayage loads. Per the playbook, only tariff-rated charges (Base Price, Pre-Pull, Chassis) on import loads are auto-approval candidates. All hand-entered charges and bill-only jobs are routed to manual review. The scenario validates every line item against the BWS charge list, checks rates, ensures no off-menu or 'other' charges, and verifies charge sources. Convergence triggers include LOAD_COMPLETED and CHARGE_PRICING_ADDED since charges may arrive after completion. Fuel Surcharge is explicitly flagged as a data error per Section 1 (BWS is all-in). Exception escalation is included because the playbook describes routing failures to manual review, which implies human notification.
